scope: Additive Royal Champion Electro Boots L1-27 passive damage aura, self-healing and balance audit.
game_version: Official December 2024 release and February 2025 balance; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Toyshop Throwdown: Clashmas Medal Event!
facts: Electro Boots are Epic Royal Champion Equipment and create an electrifying aura that periodically damages nearby targets.
sources.limitations: The event troops and spell are temporary content. No damage amount, frequency, target eligibility, geometry or healing rule is specified.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Supercell announced that Electro Boots would be toned down in the February 2025 update.
sources.limitations: No level-by-level replacement aura damage, radius, cadence, or healing table is provided.

sources.title: The Awesome Medal Event is here!
facts: Electro Boots appear as returning Royal Champion Equipment in the 2026 Trader Shop.
sources.limitations: Acquisition does not define combat mechanics.

sources.title: Electro Boots — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned Champion HP bonus 50-700 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: It does not publish the current aura damage, radius, cadence or self-heal values.

sources.title: Pinned Electro Boots Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned aura interval is 0.4 seconds with a 5 tile radius, 132-200 DPS, 52.8-80 damage per hit, and 6-45 self-healing per second.
sources.limitations: The payload does not define target eligibility, radius metric, fractional damage rounding, heal accumulation, tick phase or current balance continuity.

derivations.result: Retain pinned aura and self-heal series as catalogue provenance; keep the 2025 nerf and 2026 permanence separate from the pinned values
derivations.method: Compare official launch, balance and availability notices with raw level series and dated HP/ore table; do not derive integer damage or healing rules from fractional labels.

rejected_inferences.rule: Round 52.8-80 aura damage to nearest integer on each 400 ms pulse
rejected_inferences.reason: No source defines fractional damage accumulation or rounding, and the 2025 nerf lacks a replacement level table.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal the Champion every tick by one hundredth of selfHealingPerSecond
rejected_inferences.reason: Healing accrual, rounding, start tick and death order are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Damage every enemy within 5 center-to-center tiles
rejected_inferences.reason: The official word everything and raw radius label do not specify target classes, hitbox geometry, traps or Wall eligibility.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat Electro Boots as a temporary event effect
rejected_inferences.reason: The temporary December 2024 troops and spell are separate from the returning permanent Equipment.

items: current post-2025 aura damage, radius, cadence and healing continuity
target classes, hitbox/radius metric, Walls and invisible entities
fractional aura damage and self-heal accumulation on fixed 10 ms ticks
deployment, first pulse, movement, expiry, death and simultaneous damage order
interaction with Invisibility Spells, Pets and other Equipment
Viewer aura, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Electro Boots L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish a permanent periodic Royal Champion damage aura and a later nerf, while pinned data records radius, cadence, damage and healing labels. The current aura values, target geometry, fractional arithmetic and fixed-tick order are unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
